title: Huly bento
description: A huge tight heading over a bento of near-black cards on a pale band: narrow + wide, then wide + narrow. Each card holds a glowing mock UI and a two-tone caption at the bottom. Soft pastel light blurs behind the grid.
notes: the band follows the page's mode; the cards are always dark
cards come in pairs; an odd last card fills its row
name: huly-bento

props.name: cards
props.description: cards in pairs: narrow + wide, then wide + narrow, and so on
